recent_signals.title: Global Shipping Comes Under Attack || Peter Zeihan
recent_signals.summary: Zeihan says Hormuz throughput is neither the admin's claimed ~9 Mbd nor Iran's near-zero — Western traffic trackers imply ~3–5 Mbd vs ~20–22 Mbd pre-war, still a multi-million-barrel shortfall and 'more than enough for an energy crisis.' US overwatch enabling Arab-side 'shadow fleet' transponder-off transfers is costly and unsustainable; no power can secure all eight global chokepoints, Bab el-Mandeb/Somali piracy is already returning — insecure seas are the new normal, while disruption remains asymmetrically easy.
themes: US Navy overwatch / shadow fleet echo

calls.asset: Crude oil / energy crisis risk premium

recent_signals.title: China’s Real Estate System Is Failing || Peter Zeihan
recent_signals.summary: After Evergrande's ex-chair got life imprisonment, Zeihan frames China's property model as a completed bust: overbuilding by 4–5x plus a 35-year demographic collapse, new construction already −75% in five years with another ~20% drop expected this year, and official inflation-adjusted home values below 2005 boom-start levels. Citizens park ~$22T in deposits earning <1% rather than stocks; he calls Chinese equities a fool's errand because subsidized credit destroys equity returns, and capital controls block the only productive exit.

calls.asset: China household deposits / capital flight pressure

recent_signals.title: Why the Wall of Worry Points Higher in September

He sees near-term AI multiple expansion capped by data-center politics/churn but still expects AI ROI stocks to rebound and frames software as a durable downstream AI trade; NVDA's multiple is stuck but he argues it deserves to re-rate higher.
